verdict.rationale: Cloud Agents are documented to make changes and open pull requests in the repos they change. The Cloud Agents API supports branch/PR targeting with `autoCreatePR`, and webhook payloads carry `branchName` and `prUrl`. Agents also verify changes before pushing a PR and attach artifacts to it. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of staging and agent-written commit messages (only implied via git shell permissions), local IDE-agent git/PR workflow details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
